title: Colors, Units, and Typography
description: Understand how to apply colors, work with various units, and manage typography to create visually appealing web content.

lessons.title: Color Formats in CSS
lessons.content: CSS supports multiple color formats: named colors, HEX, RGB, RGBA, HSL, and HSLA. Each provides different flexibility for color customization.

lessons.title: Using HEX, RGB, and HSL
Applying Opacity with RGBA and HSLA
CSS Units: px, %, em, rem
lessons.content: `px` is absolute, while `%`, `em`, and `rem` are relative units useful for responsive design. `em` depends on the parent, `rem` on the root.

lessons.title: Setting Font Families
Font Size, Weight, and Style
Responsive Typography Best Practices
lessons.content: Use relative units (`em`, `rem`) and avoid fixed sizes for better accessibility. Use media queries for larger or smaller screens when needed.
